name: kanban-localstorage-app
title: Kanban Board with Drag and Drop and Local Storage
description: A lightweight, interactive Kanban board application featuring drag-and-drop task management and persistent storage via the browser's Local Storage.

tasks.title: Project Setup and HTML Structure
tasks.description: Create the main index.html file with TailwindCSS CDN integration and layout structure for columns and cards.

tasks.title: Styling and Layout Design
tasks.description: Add custom styles in styles.css for drop zones, drag states, and overall visual polish.

tasks.title: Local Storage Integration
tasks.description: Implement functions in script.js to save and load board state from the browser's localStorage.

tasks.title: Drag and Drop Functionality
tasks.description: Implement HTML5 Drag and Drop API events (dragstart, dragover, drop) to move tasks seamlessly between columns.

tasks.title: Task Management Features
tasks.description: Add functionality to create, edit, and delete tasks dynamically, updating both the UI and local storage.
